## Shared scenes

> After being punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) and forced to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) decides to leave school permanently. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) seeks advice from Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), who suggests letting [Anne](../character/anne.md) stay home until she cools down. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) finds [Anne](../character/anne.md) weeping over imaginary future sorrow about [Diana](../character/diana.md) getting married, which sends [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) into a rare fit of laughter.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> After [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne.md) attend a [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert and spend the night at Diana's, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) enjoy the event together. Upon returning home, they leap into the spare-room bed as a game, unwittingly jumping directly onto Diana's visiting great-aunt, [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md). The resulting uproar leaves [Miss Barry](../character/miss-barry.md) furious and threatens Diana's music lessons, prompting a remorseful [Anne](../character/anne.md) to seek a way to make amends.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends reenact Tennyson's Elaine on the pond, but the dory leaks and begins to sink, forcing [Anne](../character/anne.md) to cling to a bridge pile. [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rows by and rescues her, but [Anne](../character/anne.md) angrily refuses his offer of apology and friendship. Later, back at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne.md) reflects on learning her lesson about romance, while [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) gently advises her not to abandon it entirely.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) visited to recommend that she join an advanced class preparing for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. [Anne](../character/anne.md) is thrilled at the opportunity to study toward becoming a teacher and gladly accepts. After the class is organized, [Anne](../character/anne.md) navigates the dynamic of studying alongside her peers—including her rival, [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)—while missing [Diana](../character/diana.md), who is not taking the exam.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) reflects on her silent academic rivalry and unspoken regret concerning [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). As the school term ends, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) reassures her students that she will return next year to prepare them for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exam. [Anne](../character/anne.md) excitedly packs away her books for a fun summer at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), while Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) visits [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and commends Anne's growth and character.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

> [Diana](../character/diana.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne.md) dress for a concert performance at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) offers her usual blunt observations before [Anne](../character/anne.md) leaves with [Diana](../character/diana.md), Jane, and [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md). Upon arriving at the grand hotel, [Anne](../character/anne.md) experiences intense stage fright while waiting among sophisticated performers and audience members. However, after spotting [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the crowd, her pride kicks in, allowing her to deliver a brilliant recitation that wins over the audience and earns her high praise.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) adjusts to life at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), forming close friendships with [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) while continuing her intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She enjoys weekend visits home to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) during the autumn and spends spare time visiting [Miss Barry](../character/miss-barry.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood). As spring arrives and final exams loom, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends gather to discuss their anxieties, upcoming commencement clothes, and hopes for the future.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns from the oculist with news that her failing sight means she cannot read, sew, or manage [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) alone, forcing her to consider selling the farm. [Anne](../character/anne.md) refuses to let the home be sold and decides to give up her college scholarship to stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and teach locally. Later, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) informs them that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) teaching position so [Anne](../character/anne.md) could have it, leading [Anne](../character/anne.md) to reconcile with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and look forward to her future with peace and hope.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road

> Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) expresses skepticism about the [American](../codex/factions.md#american)-raised [Irving](../character/irving.md) boy coming to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and warns [Anne](../character/anne.md) against establishing a Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society). [Anne](../character/anne.md) defends her plans to improve Avonlea's appearance alongside [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Finally, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) shares the news that Anne's former classmate, [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), has been hired to teach at [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) school.
>
> — v2 · I An Irate Neighbor

> On the evening before school opens, [Anne](../character/anne.md), Jane, and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) debate their teaching methods and views on corporal punishment at a crossroads. [Anne](../character/anne.md) then walks back through her favorite spots, avoids Mrs. Lynde's unsolicited advice at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), and visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who also doubts her plan to rule without whipping. The next morning, a nervous [Anne](../character/anne.md) is comforted by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) as she prepares for her first day as a teacher.
>
> — v2 · IV Different Opinions

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) converses with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) on his porch about [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), Davy's antics, and the Village Improvement Society's hall painting project. Later, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) discovers that [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) has accidentally painted the hall a bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up in color codes. [The Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) gather at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in despair over the blunder, but the town's sympathy ultimately turns in their favor against the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes).
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color
